prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A minimalist, high-fashion scene featuring three young women standing on a pristine white platform in a stark, geometric white room. The women are positioned side by side, each striking a dynamic, dance-like pose with their arms raised above their heads, creating a sense of movement and rhythm. They wear matching sleeveless dresses with a structured, modern silhouette, adorned with bold horizontal black-and-white stripes that accentuate the clean lines of the composition. Their footwear consists of black, chunky-heeled sandals, adding a contemporary edge to the look. The lighting is bright and diffuse, casting soft shadows and emphasizing the crispness of the white environment. The overall color palette is monochromatic, dominated by whites, blacks, and subtle grays, lending a futuristic and avant-garde atmosphere. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the figures and their synchronized gestures, while the background remains abstract and uncluttered. The image exudes a sense of modern elegance, precision, and choreographed energy, reminiscent of a high-end fashion editorial or an art installation.
